name: Australia

fees.name: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Tourist stream, applied outside Australia
fees.validity: Stays of up to 3, 6 or 12 months as granted
fees.applies: all nationalities not eligible for eVisitor/ETA (e.g. IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS)
fees.notes: Base application charge from 1 July 2026 (was AUD 200). Verified via Home Affairs GetPriceList API (subclass 600-29B). Onshore (in-Australia) application is AUD 630. Frequent Traveller stream (eligible passports, e.g. CHN) is AUD 1,845; Sponsored Family and Approved Destination Status streams AUD 250. All subclass 600 applications are lodged online via ImmiAccount or on paper via an Australian Visa Application Centre.

fees.name: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Business Visitor stream
fees.applies: all nationalities not eligible for eVisitor/ETA
fees.notes: Base application charge from 1 July 2026 (subclass 600-31). ETA/eVisitor-eligible passports use those free/cheap options for business visitor activities instead.

fees.name: eVisitor (subclass 651)
fees.validity: 12 months, multiple entries, up to 3 months per stay
fees.applies: EU/EEA and certain other European passport holders (incl. GBR)
fees.notes: Free - AUD 0.00 confirmed via Home Affairs price list API. Tourism or business visitor purposes.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601)
fees.validity: 12 months (or until passport expiry), multiple entries, up to 3 months per stay
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (USA, CAN, GBR, JPN, KOR, SGP, MYS, HKG, BRN, and others)
fees.notes: No visa application charge (AUD 0.00 in Home Affairs price list); AUD 20 service fee payable in the Australian ETA app, confirmed on official Australian High Commission page. Apply only via the official Australian ETA mobile app.

fees.name: Transit visa (subclass 771)
fees.applies: nationalities not covered by transit-without-visa arrangements
fees.notes: Free - AUD 0.00 confirmed via Home Affairs price list API.

reciprocity_variations.note: UK and European passport holders use the free eVisitor (651) instead of paying the AUD 250 subclass 600 charge.
US and Canadian passport holders use the ETA (601): no visa charge, AUD 20 app service fee.

Not ETA/eVisitor-eligible; must apply for the Visitor visa (subclass 600) at AUD 250 offshore. This is nationality-based eligibility routing, not a reciprocity fee schedule - the subclass 600 charge itself is the same for all nationalities. China additionally has access to the Frequent Traveller stream (AUD 1,845, up to 10-year validity).

vfs.operator: VFS Global (Australian Visa Application Centres; TT Services in some regions)
vfs.note: Applications are normally lodged online via ImmiAccount, but biometrics collection and optional paper lodgement/assisted services go through Australian Visa Application Centres run by VFS Global (e.g. India) or TT Services. Service fees vary by centre and service; third-party sources cite roughly INR 2,000-2,500 for biometric collection in India, but no exact amount could be verified on an official VFS/government page, so amount left null.

free_visa_notes: Australia requires an authority to travel for all non-citizens, but eVisitor (651, European passports) and Transit visa (771) are free, and the ETA (601) costs only a AUD 20 app service fee. Everyone else pays AUD 250 for the offshore Visitor visa (600) from 1 July 2026.
